properties.description: Every presented data beat, independently of readiness, matches the ordered accepted prefix or completion-justified zero padding, with the correct last marker and eight-byte truncation. Unknown meaningful data cannot pass.
Every presented status describes the next completed accepted input frame: exact original length, clamped length, padding and truncation flags. Status consumption is independent of data consumption.
Blocked data and status responses retain valid and meaningful payload across the following edge unless synchronous reset cancels them.
After a reset edge both response valids are clear. Reset discards outstanding epoch inventories and blocked-response obligations, but preserves earlier alarms.
Meaningful transfer observations must be known. Accepted input frames obey the 1..12-byte bound, and bounded scoreboard inventory cannot overflow; these bounds use pre-edge inventory.

The final-post marker enables a combinational completion check with no further edge: no input offer, incomplete accepted frame, outstanding data or status, or presented response may remain. At least 32 consecutive ready-high idle edges are required; the counter also supports the supplied 128-cycle final tails. This is finite completion, not unbounded liveness.
